scenes.caption: In 1904, Russia sent 45 warships on an 18,000-mile voyage around the world to fight Japan — and it turned into the greatest disaster in naval history.

scenes.callout: FRIENDLY FIRE & PHANTOM TORPEDO BOATS across 3 OCEANS
scenes.caption: Barely out of port in the North Sea, panicked lookouts mistook British fishing trawlers for Japanese torpedo boats, and opened fire for 20 minutes.

scenes.callout: ONBOARD CHAOS: ESCAPED CROCODILES, SNAKES & TROPICAL HEAT
scenes.caption: Stopping in Madagascar, sailors adopted crocodiles and venomous snakes that escaped inside the warships, turning the fleet into a floating zoo.

scenes.callout: TACTICAL MANEUVER: ADMIRAL TOGO CROSSES THE RUSSIAN 'T'
scenes.caption: After 7 exhausting months at sea, the fleet finally reached Tsushima Strait — where Admiral Togo crossed their T and wiped them out in a single afternoon.

scenes.badge: THE AFTERMATH • END OF AN EMPIRE
scenes.callout: FINAL SCORE: 8 OF 8 RUSSIAN BATTLESHIPS LOST // 0 JAPANESE LOST
scenes.caption: Out of 8 Russian battleships, every single one was sunk or captured, while Japan didn't lose a single capital ship.
